_doc: Đợt 2 rương Không gian: tiếng bay (phi thuyền lượn nghiêng vào bến) và tiếng cập bến (động cơ hãm + khoá kẹp). Chạy: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=dummy python3 -I Tools/Audio/make_elevenlabs_chest_sfx.py --manifest Tools/Audio/manifests/chest_khong_gian.json

items.prompt: a tiny toy spaceship gliding past and banking in a smooth curve: soft rising thruster whoosh with a light electric hum, a gentle doppler sweep from left to right, then the engine eases down to a quiet purr as it slows, no music, no voice

a small spaceship docking: right at the start a sharp short retro thruster burst and a solid metallic clunk of docking clamps locking, followed by a short pneumatic hiss and a fading low engine wind down, no music, no voice
